## Experience

- Software Developer, ProFIND (2024–Present; Hamilton, Canada, remote): React/TypeScript procurement SaaS, supplier API integrations, AI-assisted development, Playwright E2E, and Node.js integration/regression tests.
- Founder & Operations Lead, Selo Oils LLC (2017–2026; United States): E-commerce operations, internal inventory and logistics software, Shopify, supplier relationships, and digital marketing.
- Technical Product Lead, OneFeather (2018–2020; Victoria, Canada): Combined product ownership and development-team leadership for SmartBallot, including requirements, implementation, and technical support. Hands-on full-stack feature development using Ruby on Rails, Ruby, JavaScript, Redis, jQuery, MySQL, and CSS.
- Cloud IT Developer, NNIT (2015–2017; Prague, Czechia): Java/Spring Boot and MVC, REST APIs, Spring Security, Hibernate, JUnit, HP Operations Orchestration, and Remedy workflows.
- Field Sales Representative, Vivint (2013–2014; Calgary, Canada): Security and home-automation sales and customer support.

## Independent Projects

- [Baba Selo source](https://github.com/SeloSlav/baba-selo-agentic-recipe-maker): Open-source AI cooking companion for Balkan recipes and meal planning with Next.js, LangChain/LangGraph, tool calling, SpacetimeDB, and PostgreSQL/pgvector. [Live app](https://babaselo.com). Additional independent Python work includes Flask services and PyTorch projects.
- [Broth & Bullets](https://github.com/SeloSlav/2d-multiplayer-survival-mmorpg): Browser-based 2D survival MMO using SpacetimeDB.
- [Arkyv Engine](https://github.com/SeloSlav/arkyv-engine): Open-source multiplayer MUD engine with AI-powered NPCs.
